kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Define the interfaces, material requirements and acceptance plan for your custom project.
intro.zh: 围绕定制项目定义接口、材料要求与验收方案。

jump.zh: 查看接口配置与材料选型

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 经原厂资料核验的接口组件参考。

intro.en: Materials identified for the specific interface or molding process.
intro.zh: 用于具体接口或成型工艺选型的材料。

copy.en: Assign responsibility for sourced parts, customer-supplied materials, tooling, fixtures, packaging and documentation before quoting.
copy.zh: 报价前明确采购件、客供物料、工装、治具、包装与文件的责任归属。

copy.en: Keep the drawing, BOM, mating parts, pin map, labels and packaging instructions on the same approved revision.
copy.zh: 让图纸、BOM、对插件、针脚表、标签与包装说明保持同一获批版本。

copy.en: Confirm approved manufacturers, exact material references and the customer approval path for any substitution.
copy.zh: 确认认可制造商、准确物料编号以及任何替代的客户审批路径。

copy.en: Agree the first-article sample, dimensional checks, circuit verification and open-point closure before repeat production.
copy.zh: 重复生产前约定首件样品、尺寸检查、回路验证与待确认项的关闭要求。

copy.en: Define inspection records, traceability, packing unit, labels and shipment acceptance requirements for the finished assembly.
copy.zh: 为成品组件定义检验记录、追溯、包装单位、标签与交付验收要求。

copy.en: Record revision authority and change approval so a repeat order reproduces the confirmed configuration.
copy.zh: 记录版本批准权限与变更审批，使重复订单复现确认的配置。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: Project and manufacturer references are shown only at their audited counts. Process requirements are defined separately from finished-product ratings.
reason.zh: 项目与原厂编号仅按实际核验数量展示，工艺要求和成品等级分别定义。
